movies.title: AVATAR 3: FIRE AND ASH
movies.overview: Avatar: Fire and Ash is an epic sci-fi adventure that continues the journey of Jake Sully and Neytiri as they protect their family and Pandora from growing threats.

movies.title: Money Heist
movies.overview: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose.

movies.title: House of the Dragon
movies.overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from heights such as these. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne.

movies.title: Game of Thrones
movies.overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II, his leadership of the Manhattan Project's Los Alamos Laboratory, and the political fallout thereafter.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.
movies.tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.

movies.title: The Last of Us
movies.overview: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the U.S. and depend on each other for survival.
movies.tagline: When you're lost in the darkness, look for the light.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Twenty years after a fungal infection devastates the planet, survivors Joel and Ellie embark on a cross-country mission.

episodes.title: When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.overview: Twenty years after a fungal outbreak ravages the planet, survivors Joel and Tess are tasked with a mission that could change everything.

episodes.title: Infected
episodes.overview: After escaping the QZ, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate while navigating the ruins of a long-abandoned Boston.

episodes.title: Long, Long Time
episodes.overview: When a stranger approaches his compound, survivalist Bill forges an unlikely connection. Years later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance.

episodes.title: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.overview: After abandoning their truck in Kansas City, Joel and Ellie must escape without drawing the attention of a vindictive rebel leader.

episodes.title: Endure and Survive
episodes.overview: While attempting to evade the rebels, Joel and Ellie cross paths with the most wanted man in Kansas City.

movies.title: Stranger Things
movies.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A young boy vanishes without a trace. As friends, family and local police search for answers, they are drawn into an extraordinary mystery.

episodes.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.overview: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn’s full-time, friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider-Society, a team of Spider-Heroes charged with protecting the Multiverse’s very existence.
movies.tagline: It's how you wear the mask that matters.

movies.title: Inception
movies.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.
movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
